Escap1ng/Escaping-Notes.body:
# Escaping Notes · Escape Notes

**STAR TRAILS · A long exposure of the night sky**

[**Try it online → escaping.top**](https://escaping.top)

[Chinese](https://github.com/Escap1ng/Escaping-Notes/blob/HEAD/README.md) · [English](https://github.com/Escap1ng/Escaping-Notes/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

Left: dark / Right: light. Neither image is a screenshot. Both are offline-recalculated exposures, computed with the site's same set of constants (`npm run art:build`). They draw only the star-trail layer, and they recompute the steady-state exposure that users with `prefers-reduced-motion` see. The output applies a ×2.8 / ×1.6 print-gain step, so the site actually looks darker than these two images.

A personal site that turns a blog into a camera long exposure: the homepage is a star-trail long exposure that accelerates as you scroll, articles are sorted by time, and collections are grouped by theme. It is purely static, finalized at build time, and pushing publishes it.

**Tech stack**: Vue 3 · Vue Router 4 · Vite 5 · Canvas 2D. At runtime there is no backend, third-party UI library, or font CDN.

**Contents**

- [This camera is counting time](#这台相机在数时间)
- [Interface](#界面)
- [Two load-bearing designs](#两处承重设计)
- [Getting started](#跑起来)
- [Adding things](#往里加东西)
- [Page map](#页面地图)
- [Directory structure](#目录结构)
- [Deployment](#部署)
- [Documentation](#文档)
- [License and usage statement](#许可与使用声明)

---

## This camera is counting time

Writing is treated as a long exposure of the night sky: a camera on the homepage counts the time for me, articles are sorted by time, and collections are grouped by theme. Three settings:

- **Scrolling is time**: within the first screen, the further you scroll down, the longer the exposure window and the faster the sky turns (1 → 3.2×). Scrolling past 1.1× the viewport height reaches the bottom.
- **Pointer is time dilation**: star trails within a 180px radius of the cursor locally accelerate and curl, faster toward the center (up to 2.8×).
- **Meteors are narrative**: one falls at random every 6–9 seconds, each lives 900ms, and up to nine can be on screen at once. While the player is playing music, the interval is compressed to 40%, and it naturally rebounds when playback stops.

Star trails are drawn only in the homepage slot. The film pixels and the site-wide clock are a singleton in `src/lib/sky.js`. Switching pages doesn't re-lay them out, and when you return to the homepage, the arc continues growing from the previous exposure. Below the polyline, the photo takes over.

Flow-speed curves, mask profiles, and meteor parameters are documented in [docs/design.md](https://github.com/Escap1ng/Escaping-Notes/blob/HEAD/docs/design.md) §3.

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

# M3W: Real-World Multimodal Agent-Scene World Model

M3W is my research project on top-down multi-agent world modeling. I study
when a neural forecast adds value over a strong motion baseline, and how to
keep the cases that the baseline already handles well from getting worse.

The long-term aim is a useful agent-scene world model. The current work is
narrower: causal trajectory forecasting, learning intervention gain and harm,
and deciding when a neural prediction should replace a physical baseline.
Combining JEPA, Transformer and other modules is not, by itself, a contribution.

## Current Result

I tested whether adding past-image alignment to each agent's history helps
without replacing its native coordinates. The new model keeps both views;
the matched control adds the same capacity without the camera transform.
There is no forced future-camera restoration or trajectory residual decoder.

SmileLee-lyx/ne-rewritten.body:
# Notation Explorer Rewritten

An expander refactored in TypeScript based on [notation-explorer](https://github.com/hypcos/notation-explorer).

While keeping the basic form of the original project's expansion tree, it adds several features that make analysis easier, such as an analysis input box (with pure-keyboard analysis shortcuts), graph drawing (mountain range diagrams, DEN diagrams, etc.), and multiple equivalent representations.

Building on the original project, it adds some notations that already have definitions in the community but previously had no expander, as well as some new notations.

This project uses AI-assisted programming.

## Online Use

<https://smilelee-lyx.github.io/ne-rewritten/>

## Local Development

Requires Node 24 (consistent with CI).

```bash
npm install
npm run dev        # local development
npm run build      # build to dist/
npm run preview    # preview the build output
```

Other scripts:

- `npm run build:compat`: build a compatibility version for older browsers into `dist-compat/`.
- `npm run build:singlefile`: build as a single file, `dist/NE-rewritten.html`.
- `npm run typecheck`: type checking.

## Custom Notations

The project supports uploading custom notations.

In the settings bar, open "Custom Notations → Configure" to create a new script, upload a `.js` file, add templates, and view or download the API documentation from within the panel.

To write custom notations, read [api.md](https://github.com/SmileLee-lyx/ne-rewritten/blob/HEAD/src/assets/api.md) and [api.ts](https://github.com/SmileLee-lyx/ne-rewritten/blob/HEAD/src/assets/api.ts) for the specification. `api.md` can also be downloaded directly from the panel and given to an AI to generate scripts.

# XECKernel Pro

An Android root solution and manager modified from [KernelSU](https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU), featuring kernel-level su, a module system, App Profile, a built-in TEE engine, and SUSFS support.

## This update: Liquid Home

- **XEC Score**: Real-time scoring across Root, SELinux, SUSFS, TEE injection, guard components, LKM, UAPI, stable release, and running mode (0–100, S/A/B/C/D). Every item is explainable.
- **Dynamic Home Hero**: Score ring, breathing glow, scan line, and guard days. The score and colors change with status, so it is no longer a static glass card.
- **Status card appearance editor**: Pick an image, preview it, set blur 0–24 dp, set dimming 0–65%, and restore defaults with one tap. Images are stored only in the app's private directory.
- **Share device card**: Generates a 1080×1440 PNG locally with Canvas, including score, device, kernel, and check items, and shares directly through the system share sheet.
- **Desktop widget + Quick Settings tile**: View the score on the desktop. Tap to enter the existing “One-Tap Hide” flow. The tile is highlighted based on status.
- **Entrance animations**: The launch splash and home cards fade in with staggered timing, preserving the layered feel of Liquid Glass.

> These are updates on the current development branch, not a “fake update” that only changes copy. All code is in this repository. Build commands are below.

## Core capabilities

| Capability | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Kernel-level root | KernelSU fork, kernel-mode su + module system |
| App Profile | Controls root / umount / non-root behavior per UID |
| TEE / TA | Built-in or external engine; the detection page can toggle, diagnose, and repair |
| SUSFS | Provided only with GKI kernel patches; not provided for LKM |
| Liquid Glass | App-wide glass, Dynamic Island, custom module card backgrounds, theme store/editor |
| XEC Score | Root / SELinux / SUSFS / TEE / Guard / LKM / UAPI / Stability / Mode |
| One-Tap Hide | OneTapHide resource pack orchestration; desktop tile/widget as the entry point |
| Device card | Generated locally; does not upload images or device info |

## UI structure

```
Home
├── XEC Score hero        score ring / aura / checks / share
├── Status card           root state, LKM/GKI, appearance editor
```

# Learn Ukrainian

**Мова -- душа народу** | Language is the soul of a nation

A free, open-source Ukrainian language course from A1 to C2, based on the **Ukrainian State Standard 2024** and aligned with **CEFR**.

**[Start Learning](https://learn-ukrainian.github.io)**

---

## What is this?

A comprehensive Ukrainian language curriculum with 1,778 modules across 22 tracks:

- **6 core CEFR levels** (A1 -- C2) covering grammar, vocabulary, and communication
- **16 specialization tracks** -- history, biographies, literature, professional Ukrainian, folk culture, Old East Slavic, and Ruthenian
- **Theory-first approach** -- understand grammar deeply, not just memorize phrases

# d2o — adaptive C-based blocking bypass

**d2o** — an independent continuation of [d2k](https://github.com/necronicle/d2k) for **OpenWrt and Keenetic** routers. The network engine detects problematic connections, tests bypass options, and saves working strategies. The package includes a web panel, Discord voice support, a DNS helper for Instagram/WhatsApp, and a local Telegram proxy **in C11**.

**Idea:** choose a solution based on the behavior of real traffic, rather than maintaining a manual list of 'blocked sites'. The core engine runs directly on the router, without a mandatory VPN, WARP, or external server. Some download and DNS features use the project's network infrastructure.

> **Independent project.** d2o is not an official release of d2k or z2k and does not represent their teams. Some executable and command names remain `d2k` for compatibility — this is normal and does not mean installation from a different repository. Wuma Tracker is a desktop application that shares in-game player positions for the game **Wuthering Waves** in real time and integrates them with web maps.   * **Intuitive UI**: Provides a clean, easy-to-use interface based on SvelteKit and Tailwind CSS.

-----

---

FileCat is a web file server that you deploy yourself, and it is also a **lightweight server management tool**. Once deployed, you can manage files on your server from a browser anywhere, anytime, and enjoy a rich set of operations and maintenance features.

FileCat is built using the UI of [filebrowser](https://github.com/filebrowser/filebrowser).

> **Core philosophy**: Centered on file management, it integrates AI Agent, remote desktop, intranet penetration, system monitoring, and other capabilities to make server management simpler.

---

## Features

| Category | Feature |
|------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| File management | Browse, upload, download, edit, and preview online (images, videos, Markdown, diagrams, etc.) |
| Cloud drives & protocol mounts | Mount Baidu Netdisk, SSH (SFTP), S3, WebDAV, and SMB as local directories, using the same operations as local files |
| Markdown WYSIWYG | Typora-like Markdown editing experience, what you see is what you get |
| AI Agent | Integrates large language models to intelligently assist with operations and file handling (requires configuring your own API). Supports connecting third-party platform bots for QQ, WeCom, Feishu, and DingTalk |
| Intranet penetration | Expose intranets to the public internet, or enable communication between multiple intranets. Based on this, each client can have a seamless file operation experience. For needs like CI/CD, you can deploy a client on multiple machines to perform cross-machine CI/CD automated builds |

# MDCx

 

 

 

We've burned through too many tokens and can't cover the costs. Two months of continuous high-intensity updates consumed tens of billions of tokens. I've invested too much with no sponsorship and no return; so far I've received only one donation, totaling 100 yuan. The time and effort invested are too great, and free distribution can't continue. The software is switching to a paid model: 500 yuan per license, bound to one machine. After the switch to licensed distribution, the software's features will keep being updated and various issues will continue to be fixed. If someone is bored enough to file a report, the software will be taken down at any time. Anyway, I have the source code myself and can modify it freely for unlimited use.

To get a license file, add me on Telegram for a private chat, or join the group and message me privately: https://t.me/+OVnB6Cw8gkxlYzM1

## What is MDCx

MDCx is a desktop tool that automatically scrapes metadata for video files (titles, cast, cover art, synopses, etc.) from 47 websites. It generates standard .nfo files and organized folders, ready to use directly with media servers such as Emby, Jellyfin, and Kodi.

In one sentence: it turns a pile of messy video files into a tidy library that media servers can recognize.

## Quick Install

Download the installer or executable for your system from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/cdlongbow/MDCx/releases). On Linux, run `chmod +x MDCx` before the first launch, then run `./MDCx`.

Detailed installation instructions: [docs/Install.md](https://github.com/z291173301/MDCx/blob/HEAD/docs/Install.md)
